checks.time: 120000ms starts before runtime fetch, browser launch, public navigation and import, and covers every application recovery call and same-read comparison. Static module imports and pre-run local input validation occur before this acceptance clock. Context close is cleanup; outer existing Supervisor enforces 150000ms and 3GiB tree RSS with owned-tree absence.
checks.sameRead: Calls unchanged runtime.createSession (returns existing session), then production application.readColdPreferences. Tests revision3, exact bookmarks/followed boards, matching canonical read marker and no orphaned markers from that single complete return. Does not perform an extra anchor-changing read after completion. Expected values are never written to application storage.
checks.observer: Existing fail-closed request classifier allows only local public/read RPC/compact paths; blocks sends/proof jobs/WebSockets and unknown routes; service workers blocked. Cold aggregate requires compact requests and no tag discovery. Request classification is not a full response-body or backend-ingress privacy trace.
checks.retry: Loop advances ordinary incomplete recovery pages monotonically. Exceptions exit false; no automatic retry, reset, error suppression, cursor skipping or fallback found. Diagnostic observation failure may yield unavailable metadata but cannot turn a failed recovery into pass.
checks.sourceBinding: Runtime JSON bytes are fetched and hashed against lead-supplied SHA. Source revision is only format-validated environment metadata, not independently measured remote Git/source/asset identity. Lead must attach exact remote source archive/materialized SDK/wallet manifest/served assets binding; old-source result cannot qualify changed UI without scoped equivalence.
